description_ru: Голоцен. Аллювиальные отложения русел рек и пойм. Валунно-галечные отложения, галечники, гравийники, пески, алевриты, илы, глины, торф (7-10 м)
note: GGK-200/2 N-51-XV (Urusha), Stanovaya series, Quaternary map, 2nd edition (compiled FGUGP Amurgeologiya, author S.N. Belikov, editor V.V. Kolesnikov; approved NRS MPR RF 21 Nov 2000; signed to print 28 Dec 2004 at the VSEGEI cartographic factory, (c) Rosnedra 2004), frame 122-123E, 54-54d40mN; RASTER = geokniga 2000x2406 px PREVIEW (~36 m/px); tints calibrated on the map from the legend swatches (preview_tint_calib.py, drift 1.6-5 dE for the slope units; label-centred sampling fails here because e labels sit beside their small polygons on leader lines), pH pinned to its swatch, thinned 2 px with --class-dE 6 (valley-edge mixtures otherwise read as pH); a1III and pre-Quaternary formations only on the correlation scheme; frame = 4 corners on the frame-line centre (ridge filter) + 9 interior 15x10 min graticule crossings + 11 frame ticks
